messages:
Jordan Kim: FYI onboarding for Lodestar hitting 429s in sandbox after we rotated the keystore at ~09:12 PT. Root logs show a handful of `401 -> 429` on token refresh wave.

Priya Nair: are they using ephemeral tokens or long-lived keys?

Jordan Kim: ephemeral via the browser SDK. They refresh every 60s by default. Headers show `x-rw-limit-remaining: 0` spikes and some `Invalid signature` entries right after rotate.

Ashwin Rao: sounds like a race: clients with old tokens firing retries + new tokens causing preflight fanout. Can you paste the small log snippet?

Jordan Kim: pasted snippet: `2026-01-28T16:12:21Z ERROR auth signature_mismatch token_id=abc123; 2026-01-28T16:12:22Z WARN rate 429 Retry-After:2 path=/v1/generate client=browser-sdk`

Kayla (devex): @Jordan Kim can you repro locally with multiple tabs? also, what does their preflight pattern look like?

Jordan Kim: repro steps I ran: rotate keystore, open 20 tabs that immediately refresh. Command I used: `for i in {1..20}; do curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/preflight & done` — you can see a fanout of preflight + session create.

Ashwin Rao: mitigation checklist: 1) add a short grace window after keystore rotate so old tokens validate for ~30s, 2) gate bursts on gateway with a burst-protection token-level semaphore, 3) recommend client jitter/exponential-backoff for refresh. I'll open an infra ticket for the grace window.

Priya Nair: also tell Lodestar to bump refresh interval to 90s temporarily and add jitter; that alone often flattens the spike.

Jordan Kim: I asked Lodestar to adjust to 90s + randomized jitter(0..500ms). They applied change at 16:25 PT.

infra-bot: INF-8421 created: "Keystore rotation: add grace window & rate-limit tuning for onboarding fanout" — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-8421

Jordan Kim: after the client change we saw 429s drop from ~120/s to ~6/min within 2 minutes. Lodestar confirms reduced errors. :tada:

Kayla (devex): follow-ups: I'll add a short KB snippet in onboarding docs with sample jitter code and recommended refresh intervals. Priya — can you update the quickstart note about keystore rotates and ephemeral token fanout?

Priya Nair: on it. I'll add a one-liner and link to INF-8421.

Ashwin Rao: assigned INF-8421 to infra, we'll evaluate adding a 30s grace and gate at gateway. ETA: 3d for a temp config change, 2w for full rollout.

Jordan Kim: Great — thanks team. Marking issue as triaged on the customer side; Lodestar is green for now.

Kayla (devex): note to self: include a short code block in KB: `const refresh = () => setTimeout(refresh, 60000 + Math.floor(Math.random()*500));` — small but very effective.

Jordan Kim: closing the thread for now, will reopen if Lodestar sees regression.
